status: PREDECLARED research-only historical closed-trade screening; no results inspected

rules.source_bar_timestamps: UTC H1 bar OPEN times; close becomes usable only at open+3600 <= source entry
rules.lookback_age_anchor: entry timestamp for both volatility and correlation; return endpoints must be >= entry minus 10 days
rules.volatility_end: before the signal 3-hour block (return endpoint <= signal-start close)
rules.threshold: sqrt(3) * sampleSD(previous 120 valid one-hour DXY log returns)
rules.primary: Veto long only if 3-hour DXY log return >= threshold; veto short only if <= -threshold
rules.secondary: Apply primary veto only if rolling paired XAUUSD/DXY hourly log-return correlation <= -0.25
rules.missing_or_stale_policy: PASS original trade unchanged; report missingness and common-valid comparison; never zero-fill or forward-fill prices
rules.secondary_selection: One predeclared diagnostic; not select whichever wins or claim untouched out-of-sample

metrics.risk_model: Unlimited fractional-lot fixed $100 initial-stop risk per native position; no compounding, margin, lot minimum or portfolio guards; linear cost scaling, not a tradable-account simulation
metrics.profit_model: NetR=(unit_gross+unit_comm+unit_swap)/unit_risk at original natural close; netR*100 dollars; closed-position curve books entire net at close including source entry costs
metrics.return_model: Closed-position net dollars / initial $10000 reference; exclude open/unclosed positions and native forced final liquidations
metrics.period_membership: source entry >= UTC period start AND natural close < UTC end-exclusive; no pre-window carried position or final forced close; both boundaries apply before filtering
metrics.close_tie_order: close epoch, open epoch, EA key, numeric position_id
metrics.drawdown: Closed-position chronological net curve only, NOT floating equity or daily prop loss
metrics.streaks: Chronological close ordering; zero result breaks win and loss streak
metrics.sharpe: UTC daily closed-position returns on current closed reference balance, all calendar days, sqrt(365); unavailable if nonpositive balance

data.dxy_source: Broker DXY CFD H1, Exness-MT5Trial15; not official ICE spot/futures
data.native_gold_source: Frozen historical single-EA sources from Exness-MT5Trial16; 15% real ticks globally, real ticks begin January2026

limitations: Entry-veto subset screening cannot recover later/counterfactual entries made possible by skipped trades; native on/off reruns required before adoption.
Not a new full EA backtest, a prop-phase simulation, or a proven probability of success.
Existing strategies/dates already researched. No claim of genuinely untouched last-two-year OOS.
